question: Can a retained static call-compatibility lens turn actual dependency changes into useful source-bound upgrade reports, and do supported incremental benefits repay its complete investment?
observed_need: Alpha directly declares FastAPI and Requests and captures urllib3 as a requests-side dependency; existing source inventory reports declarations/imports but not cross-version call-shape containment or captured caller exposure.
demand: Observed internal project dependency-maintenance need; historical release transitions are representative recurring assessments, not paid orders or prospective field deployments.

scope.input: Public, source-pinned Python package histories, read as data only; no inspected source imports or execution.
scope.callables: Direct top-level function/async-function declarations with names not starting underscore, subject to explicit unsupported-declaration rules. Also direct, undecorated class __init__ declarations, labeled unbound signature; consumer mapping supplies implicit self.
scope.guarantee: Whether some positional-count/keyword-name call shape accepted by the old declared signature is rejected by the new declared signature.
excluded: arbitrary methods/descriptors other than explicit constructors
scope.native_bounds: Unchanged native SourceFile/SourcePackage and Workbench policy; refusals retained. New local analysis is not native source-audit admission or production adoption.

trigger: New substantive package-source bytes or changed assessment requirement. Unchanged byte inventories return a no-op. Rows/functions/assertions/timing repeats/arms are not extra jobs.

arms.method: Existing native TI static source inventory plus ordinary source diff; legitimate caching and scripts retained. This does not already implement call-compatibility; missing outcome is recorded, never a fabricated wrong answer.
Same source/diff evidence plus retained static signature constraints and explicit counterexample witness generation; same exact input and independent validation.
Independent conventional builder using Griffe 2.4.1 static extraction/checks plus reusable safe-stub witness enrichment; construction and maintenance charged; broader alerts reported separately.

development: Exposed Alpha main and native sources, public HTTPX 0.27.2 to 0.28.1 migration example and hand-authored signature controls. These are not held-out evidence.

confirmation.selection: Latest five stable published releases each of Requests, FastAPI and urllib3 at metadata collection; four consecutive transitions per project, selected without outcomes.
confirmation.exposure: Source bodies held from both constructors until exact implementation and independent verifier freeze. Public historical data may have been present in model training; this is held-out historical transfer, not prospective unseen-release evidence.
confirmation.adjacency: Shared release snapshots between adjacent missions are deliberate operational reuse; twelve transitions are not twelve independent defect families.
confirmation.ordering: Per project oldest to newest; all methods get identical retained source snapshots and may cache content; arm order rotated across timed replicates.
confirmation.constructors: Direct qualified constructors are unbound signatures, including self; consumer-level class-call behavior and __new__/MRO remain outside guarantee.

primary_acceptance: Every changed module accounted for, including explicit parse/policy/unsupported outcomes
Every reported lost-call witness independently accepted before and rejected after by inert Python stubs
Supported no-loss statements agree with independent finite-domain checker
Downloadable machine report and concise user action for each substantive transition
All complete costs and unknowns retained

admission.engineering: Eligible only for local research use if all soundness/integrity controls pass; retain conventional broader alerts and alternatives; operator/release scope remains separate.
admission.economic: Requires supported incremental monetary benefit and complete construction/operating/maintenance cost over justified recurrence. Unknown construction/inference cost or unmeasured attention cannot be zeroed. No receipts/prices will be fabricated.
admission.succession: Only after economic qualification could earned surplus finance another asset. If only engineering qualifies, demonstrate reuse on later missions but do not claim self-financing/acceleration.

costs.model: Research assistant/model construction present; no per-call billed token telemetry available; runtime calls explicitly counted
costs.human: No recruited duration or attention saving; one-time research contributions disclosed
costs.resources: CPU ns, wall ns, bytes, parser/witness operations, subprocess/request counts and all failed work
costs.economics: Reuse exact canonical alpha-automated-costs/v1 and shadow ledger source candidate; nontransactional only

fallback.rule: If primary fails, preserve all outcomes. Any revised confirmation needs new untouched source; no tuning and retesting the same holdout as fresh.

publication: Additive research namespace; preserve earlier papers and histories; coordinate through issue4850 and existing owner process. No release or deployment inferred.
amendment: Before confirmation bodies/outcomes, replace Pydantic with actual transitive dependency urllib3 because native development imports used installed Pydantic2.14.1. Selection remains latest5 stable releases, no outcome screening.

offering.buyer: Maintainer or engineering lead reviewing a public Python dependency upgrade
offering.deliverable: Source-pinned upgrade decision packet with changed declarations, affected captured consumer call sites, verified binding counterexamples, unresolved scope and explicit follow-up tests/review actions. No migration, production deployment or blanket compatibility certification.
offering.customer_inputs: Exact public consumer revision/scope and old/new dependency revisions
offering.acceptance: Every declared input accounted; no false source/call witness; affected known call shape linked to exact file/line; dynamic cases remain unresolved; machine data plus readable EN/FR report.
alternatives: Dependabot free dependency update pull requests
offering.price: Not established; broader advertised human assessments are context, not a matched price.

consumer_lane.strict: Exact source-grounded imports and supported direct call shapes only; report uncertainty and unresolved scope.
consumer_lane.candidate: Closed literal wildcard exports and import-or-raise guards may emit separately labeled syntactic candidates; runtime export identity unproved, never promoted to strict findings.
consumer_lane.triage: All captured call nodes accounted, dependency-import references separated from other imports and unattributed calls; counts are not jobs.
consumer_lane.common_component: Same mapper on both completed methods with independently produced signatures; candidate mapping shared, not evidence of an independent method advantage.

operating_model.execution: Unchanged native Workbench extension with fixed local Python worker, exact registered snapshots, actual native inventory and independent verification; unauthenticated local history, no active authority.
operating_model.recurrence: 12 historically selected substantive transitions maximum; any equal-source pair becomes no-op and is excluded from productive mission count.
operating_model.cache: Exact source snapshots available to every arm; retained facts persisted on disk; conventional parsed facts/Griffe snapshots reusable in same serial worker with bounded memory. Each timing replicate starts a fresh worker and retained cache; three repetitions do not multiply demand.
operating_model.construction: All new assets research-assistant authored, model/token billing unavailable. Known historical repair supplied from upstream, not autonomous invention.

preconfirmation_amendments: v2 adds consumer/constructor outcome after commercial steering; v3 replaces exposed runtime Pydantic with uninspected urllib3; final metadata parity/integrity checks correct development-only faults, all logs preserved.
